Audit complete. Evidence-based report:

## Audit report — pi-goal-list-loop-audit (attempt `audit-mtn0xed8-5c4id1`)

Objective: `Gates + CHANGELOG` (task 6 of the goal file `.pi-glla/goals/20260904100818-bwaxee.md`; tasks 1–5 spot-checked as the surrounding contract).

### Gate 6.1 — targeted tests
Full suite run (`bun test --parallel=1 --max-concurrency=1 --timeout=60000`, 191.65s): **1815 pass / 2 skip / 7 fail** across 177 files — exactly matches the claimed count. Every targeted file (process, timeout-settings, completions, stale pins, behavioral, settings) passes; all 7 fails are in `tests/subagent-polish.test.ts` + `tests/subagent-model-override.test.ts`.

### Gate 6.2 — tsc + baseline
- `npx tsc --noEmit` → **"TypeScript: No errors found"**, exit 0.
- All 7 fails share one root cause: `AssertionError: current pi-subagents definition is installed: delegate` — `node_modules/pi-subagents` does not exist in this environment (`ls: cannot access 'node_modules/pi-subagents': No such file or directory`). Model-pin assertions, environmental.
- Pre-existence: neither failing file is touched by commit `8b6e9073` (its `--stat` lists 21 files, none of them); last modification predates this work (`5562c059`). Zero regressions attributable to the commit.
- `node tests/repro-jiti-state-split.test.mjs` → exit 0. `npm run test:auditor-extensions` → `OK … VERIFIED offline auditor extension loading`.

### Gate 6.3 — CHANGELOG
Unreleased section now contains only: retention fix, `auditJobRetentionMs` setting, and the new **`auditorInspection` entry** ("opt-in `auditorInspection` setting (global-only; default off)… `--session <jobDir>/session.jsonl`… Off (default) keeps the original `--no-session` spawn byte-identical"). All reverted transcript-widget/F9//glla-transcript entries are gone from Unreleased.

### Gate 6.4 — node_modules
`git ls-files node_modules | wc -l` → **0** (untracked, gitignored line 55). Working tree clean except runtime telemetry `.pi-glla/active.jsonl`. No tamper indicators — the baseline tests fail precisely because the package is *absent*, not patched.

### Tasks 1–5 spot-checks (all hold)
- Revert: zero references to `auditor-transcript`/`cmdTranscript`/`openAuditorTranscript` in `extensions/ tests/ scripts/`; no `registerShortcut`/F9 in `goal-activation.ts` or `mock-pi.ts`; `extensions/auditor-transcript.ts` + its test deleted (in commit stat).
- Setting: `goal-settings.ts` key + `auditorInspection: false` default + both key lists; `settings-menu.ts` row; `goal-settings-ui.ts:1139` boolean editor case; headless dump line `goal-commands.ts:2699`.
- Worker: `scripts/goal-auditor-worker.mjs:394/466/572` — `request.inspection` → `sessionPath` → `...(sessionPath ? ["--session", sessionPath] : ["--no-session"])`.
- Dispatch: `inspection: settings.auditorInspection === true` at both sites (`goal-auditor-hooks.ts:1077`, `goal-tools.ts:834`). Note: threading is via request field, not a `GLLA_AUDITOR_SESSION_INSPECTION` env var — same semantics as task 4.1/5.1 require; mechanism detail, not a gap.
- Live line: `goal-loop-display.ts` observations push `session: <path> — tail -f it live`. Approval notes at `goal-auditor-hooks.ts:1448` + `goal-tools.ts:1272` ("Auditor session kept for review: pi --session … (or pi --fork …)").
- New tests: real-worker spawn-spec both modes + progress shape in `tests/auditor-process.test.ts` (asserts argv `--session <jobDir>/session.jsonl`, absence of `--no-session`, and reverse for default) — present and passing in the full run. File spawns fake `pi` binaries in temp dirs with cleanup; **no test invokes the project's own runner — no fork-bomb pattern**.

### Quality bar
Not a scaffold: opt-in feature with byte-identical default path, real-worker integration tests proving both spawn modes end-to-end, user-facing surface (settings row/editor/dump line, audit-card line, post-completion notify), accurate CHANGELOG. User-facing value (live read-only `tail -f` while running, interactive resume after) is genuinely delivered and verified at the spawn boundary.

## Verdict
All four gate items of the objective verified against executed artifacts; tasks 1–5 semantically confirmed; failure baseline proven environmental and pre-existing.

<approved/>
